methods.name: Quest skip to level 34
methods.note: Witch's Potion and Imp Catcher give level 10. The Grand Tree, Watchtower and one more small quest reach 34. All fights can be safespotted.

methods.name: Rock crabs with earth spells
methods.note: Rellekka. Aggressive for 10 minutes, then walk off to reset. A 20% earth weakness. No requirements. Rate estimated from your best earth spell: the wiki gives none.

methods.name: Frost crabs with fire spells
methods.note: Ruins of Tapoyauik in Varlamore. A 100% fire weakness doubles fire spell damage. Reset aggression every 10 minutes. Rate estimated: the wiki gives none.

methods.name: Gemstone Crab with combat spells
methods.note: Never moves you, two clicks every 10 minutes. The wiki rates it below the other crabs for Magic: no weakness and 87.5% XP. Rate estimated.

methods.name: Splashing
methods.note: Wear -64 Magic attack and autocast on a weak monster, one click every 20 minutes. 6,600 is the lowest spell. Up to 75,750 with the highest spells.

methods.name: Arceuus Library books
methods.note: Each book handed in gives 15 times your Magic level. 120 books an hour with the Kourend Library plugin, 150 with stamina. No runes needed.

methods.name: Enchanting bolts
methods.note: Enchant Crossbow Bolt clicked every tick, 5,500 casts an hour. Very expensive. Autocasting gives about a third. Can be done while running or questing.

methods.name: Enchanting jewellery
methods.note: Lvl-1 to Lvl-5 Enchant on jewellery bought from the GE, about 1,600 casts an hour. Usually a small profit. Lvl-5 needs tens of millions in capital.

methods.name: Mage Training Arena
methods.note: Up to 127,000 XP in total on the way to Bones to Peaches. From 68 the Enchanting Chamber with a mud battlestaff costs no runes overall.

methods.name: Superheat Item
methods.note: 53 XP a cast plus Smithing XP. Ironmen superheat their own iron or gold ore and the guide warns it eats nature runes. Only listed for 43 to 55.

methods.name: High Level Alchemy
methods.note: 65 XP a cast, 78k an hour at most standing still. Expect 20k to 50k when alching alongside other training. Ironmen alch Slayer drops and crafted items.

methods.name: Blood bursting desert bandits
methods.note: Big Heist Lodge in the Bandit Camp wearing a Saradomin or Zamorak item. Blood spells keep you healed. Up to 150k bursting or 230k barraging. Runes are not recouped.

methods.name: Bursting maniacal monkeys
methods.note: Ice Burst, then Ice Barrage at 94, in Kruk's Dungeon. Fastest viable Magic XP. On auto retaliate expect 250k bursting or 320k barraging.

methods.name: Burst or barrage Slayer tasks
methods.note: Dust devils, nechryaels, smoke devils and warped jellies on task. Usually breaks even or profits. The ironman route for most Magic XP at high level.

methods.name: Cure Me on araxytes
methods.note: Tick-perfect. Cast Cure Me every tick while araxytes in the Morytania Spider Cave keep you venomed. Up to 414k at 6,000 casts an hour. Needs prayer potions.

methods.name: Plank Make
methods.note: Autocast on mahogany logs, about 90 seconds an inventory. Manual casting gives 166k. Small profit for mains. Ironmen need their own logs.

unverified: Quest skip to level 34: one-off quest XP, so no hourly rate (xph 0); the main guide uses Fairytale I or The Grand Tree plus Watchtower and the Lumbridge Guide subquest, the Ironman Guide uses The Grand Tree, Watchtower and The Giant Dwarf
Crabs with combat spells: no rate in either guide (xph 0)
Splashing: the guide gives a range of 6,600-75,750 depending on the spell with no levels; the low end is used at lv 1
Arceuus Library books: rates are level x 15 x 120 books an hour from the Ironman Guide table; the main guide recommends it from 20 and quotes about 200,000 an hour at 75 when alching between books
Enchanting bolts: table rates assume 5,500 manual one-tick casts an hour; topaz bolts at 29 (181,500) are slower than emerald at 27 and left out of the bands
Enchanting jewellery: rates are from the profitable-methods table; the text elsewhere says 'up to around 32,000' for Lvl-1 Enchant
Mage Training Arena: the guide gives a total (up to 127,000 XP) rather than an hourly rate (xph 0)
High Level Alchemy: 66,300 is 85% of 'up to 78,000'
Blood bursting desert bandits: 127,500 is 85% of 'can reach 150,000' with Blood Burst; the Blood Barrage level is not stated so no second band; needs Desert Treasure I for Ancient Magicks
Bursting maniacal monkeys: bands are 85% of 'up to around 310,000' (Ice Burst) and 'up to around 400,000' (Ice Barrage); only needs Monkey Madness II started; the guide suggests two alts to stack
Burst or barrage Slayer tasks: no Magic XP rate in either guide (xph 0); 65 Slayer is for dust devils
Cure Me on araxytes: 351,900 is 85% of 'up to 414,000 optimally', a one-tick method
Plank Make: the Ironman Guide only links to the Plank Make page and gives no rate

Not included to stay within 14 methods: Low Level Alchemy (up to 60,000 from 21), Camelot Teleport (about 80,000 from 45), tele-alching (up to 144,600 from 55), String Jewellery (up to 150,000 from 80), stun-alching (184,000 from 80), Wilderness bandits with Ice Barrage (up to 330,000, profitable)

2026-10-05: the three crab entries are computed in app.js (CALC rock-magic / frost-magic / gem-magic) from the spell pages (level, base XP, max hit; earth spells at their lower max hit) and Elemental weakness (+1% damage and accuracy per point); 1,200 casts an hour assumes 5-tick autocasting; 2 XP per damage plus base XP per cast; frost and rock crabs take a 10% allowance for resets and overkill, the Gemstone Crab its 87.5% XP
